title: ADIndex: Layer-Adaptive Sparse Attention Indexing via Group-Level Distillation
topic: 稀疏索引与共享候选库
code_status: 固定 v1、arXiv资源与作者链接未找到ADIndex原作者代码；SGLang与被引用的Math/DSA仓库不等于本篇实现。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.foundation_models.adindex import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42, device="cpu"))'

cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 frozen backbones; original DSA and layer-specific student indexers
cost_assessment.data_scale: 1,000 128K-token sequences with all-layer hidden/key caches, disjoint 100-sequence calibration; 256,000 train and 64,000 validation groups per layer
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: 8 data-parallel workers, 1,000 optimizer updates per layer; SGLang model evaluation on NVIDIA B300 GPUs
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Full large-backbone extraction, caches, multi-layer training and long-context serving matrix exceed a short single-device budget; no GPU-hour estimate is invented.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅实现小张量组索引器、前向KL蒸馏与因果候选精排，不下载backbone或语料。

summary: 按层校准相邻query的Top-K并集容量，用max/min/mean池化训练较少head的组索引器；共享候选库后仍加入新可见token并由原DSA逐query精排。本地只验证算子与小规模梯度，不证明生产吞吐。
